text: ARTIFACT gap_finding: No spec states a regeneration unit. I searched `plugins/temperspec-tgraph/docs/specs/` for "regenerat", "stamp" and "generated". The only hit is `capability-list.spec.md`, which is about the capability list. `code-join.spec.md` (lines 1-11) is in the earlier numbered layout and has no behaviours or criteria. It says `code_join` "produces no file, and has no session, gate, check or effect". It is "a route", and its criteria section reads "None: a join has no gate criteria". It sends a quick-lane run to the outcome gate and every other run to `independent_review`, so the outcome gate follows the review. A new unit has to fit into that path. `overview.spec.md` lists the units at lines 18-27, with `code_join` at line 26 and `independent_review` at line 27. Lines 29-30 hold the "Beside the units" list, which names `repository-commands.spec.md`, so a new spec must be added there. In code, `workflow/temperspec/__init__.py:279` defines `code_join` as `Route(select=route_code_join, targets=["independent_review","finalizer"])`. `workflow/temperspec/routing.py:274-279` returns `finalizer` when `route == "quick"`, else `independent_review`. `finalizer` is the outcome gate. The `code` step (`__init__.py:266-276`) has `after=[_commit()]` and `back_targets=["plan","discovery","triage"]`. `independent_review` (`__init__.py:284-294`) uses `Script` units with `side_effects="workspace"` for `before` and `after`, and ends with `_commit()`. The same lines show the existing way to write a script unit and commit its files. The `code_mode` switch (`__init__.py:245-249`) uses `joins_at="code_join"`, and its comment says a join may not be the entry of an arm. The triage note's G1 row says the new unit sits "after `code_join` and before the outcome gate". The existing routing sends non-quick runs through the review first, so where exactly it sits is undecided. I did not read the plan or the engine's script-unit code.
